item.description:
• The builder loads local-deps.lisp from the project root to register local systems, instead of roswell/local-deps.lisp.

  • Fixed compilation on CCL when CFFI or conduit-packages are not loaded yet: the ccl module resolves their symbols at run time and install-ccl-patches quickloads both libraries before installing the patches, so the module no longer references their packages at read time.

• Initial version. Extracted from the pingvito project's build.lisp script. Supports SBCL, CCL and ECL, pins the git commit and the changelog version into the dumped image, and bundles the Deploy runtime together with Slynk contribs.
